title: Finish Canonical Linux Worker Setup on Workstation Lin 1
description: Finish setting up this worker (g1-m04, SteamOS, account deck) as the canonical Linux worker: one synchronized repository at ~/semio instead of several clones. Relocate the joined replica from /srv/semio into the existing repository ~/semio, verify (status, verify, fleet, preflight), fix what blocks it (stuck NFS transport, preflight symlinked mount), retry the native bootstrap and retire the old tree.
summary: Worker g1-m04 runs from the canonical worktree /home/deck/semio as the only, synchronised repository. The native build stays pending: the failing setup tasks reduce to two open protocol decisions in the shared build code (authority for the nested tools setup, roles of the dependencies partition) that block the tools setup on every worker; no build code was changed from this machine. Details in report.md, section "Third Pass".
